name: flat8
label: 3.0 L flat-eight, racing, open megaphones
notes: Invented, typical engine: dimensions are round numbers for this layout, not measurements of a real one. A boxer: opposed pistons on separate crank pins 180 degrees apart, the four pairs on a two-plane (90-degree) crank, firing evenly every 90 degrees. Each bank has its own 4-into-1 megaphone, so each side fires unevenly (270-180-90-180) as a cross-plane V8's banks do. The layout and firing order are invented, not taken from any real flat-eight.
